title: Weak Convergence and Gaussian Limits for a General-Dimensional Origin-Invariant Cramér--von Mises Statistic
summary: We introduce a general-dimensional origin-invariant Cramér--von Mises statistic $\barω_d^2$ for testing complete spatial randomness, defined by averaging corner-oriented empirical-distribution-function discrepancies over all $2^d$ corners of $[0,1]^d$. The statistic has a closed-form $O(n^2)$ computing formula. For $d=1$ it reduces to the classical rank-based Cramér--von Mises statistic, while for $d=2$ its computing formula agrees with Zimmerman's origin-invariant statistic.
